scope: Same pinned native F16 runtime/weights on two actual T4s; pipeline scheduling versus existing GGML graph reuse. Both orders, initial + three warm calls per clip, all 48 outputs exact against independent F32 source text/timestamp bounds. Full stage/cache/magnitude, five-file, CLI/ABI and three Piper checks pass. These counters do not establish CUDA graph capture, and this is not a broad accuracy corpus or proof on other GPU types. Current default retained.
